name: HealthSearchQA
intro: HealthSearchQA 是 Google 在 MultiMedQA 中引入的开放式消费者医疗问答数据集。arXiv v1 报告 3,375 题；最终 Nature 论文及官方补充表修订为 3,173 题。问题由医学病症及症状作为种子，取自搜索引擎向所有输入种子词用户公开展示的常见问题；公开资产只提供问题，不含参考答案。
build_method: 医学状况与症状种子, 公开常见搜索问题检索与策划
metric: 12个临床医生评估轴, 普通用户意图与有用性评分, 1,000次Bootstrap区间
eval_feature: 消费者健康查询, 无参考答案, 医学共识与伤害评估, 普通用户效用评估
scale: Nature最终版3,173条仅含问题查询（arXiv v1为3,375条）
build_method_en: Medical-condition and symptom seeds, retrieval and curation of publicly shown common search questions
eval_feature_en: Consumer health queries, no reference answers, medical consensus and harm review, lay-user utility evaluation
intro_en: HealthSearchQA is Google's open-ended consumer medical QA dataset introduced with MultiMedQA. arXiv v1 reports 3,375 questions; the final Nature article and official supplement revise the release to 3,173. Questions come from public search-engine suggestions shown to all users entering medical-condition and symptom seeds. The official asset contains questions only, with no reference answers.

drawio_review_note: Version reconciliation is explicit: arXiv:2212.13138v1 reports 3,375 questions and 100 bootstrap replicas, while the final Nature article (doi:s41586-023-06291-2) and official supplement contain 3,173 questions and use 1,000 bootstrap replicas; the downloaded workbook SHA-256 begins a89f6639. Its 'All HealthSearchQA Questions' sheet has 3,173 non-empty rows and its study sheet has 140 questions. The release is question-only and supplies neither answers nor an automatic evaluator. The blinded human study samples 100 HealthSearchQA, 20 LiveQA, and 20 MedicationQA questions disjoint from tuning, compares clinician references with Flan-PaLM and Med-PaLM, assigns each answer to one of nine clinicians across 12 axes, and separately uses five non-medical raters for intent and helpfulness.
